messages:
jamie: Heads-up: tenant IPs are appearing in CP traces via peering. Need a privacy-safe metrics pattern.

marta: Two short options: local telemetry agent that redacts and emits tenant_hash+svc, or gateway-side redaction with sampling.

devin: Agent is best for privacy; gateway required for cross-account peering.

lina: Agent should only emit tenant_hash, svc_qualifier, region, session_token. No IPs or ports.

kevin: SNI can be rewritten. Fallback to ALPN/port mapping or explicit header from agent.

marta: For peering we can do a token-exchange: customer registers conn, gets telemetry_token, gateway uses token to label metrics.

jamie: Ops want per-endpoint latency histograms without PII. Use ephemeral session_token with short TTL.

devin: Spike plan: sidecar prototype (lina, 2d) + gateway token prototype (devin, 3d). Measure latency and token-store QPS.

ops-bot: Compliance ticket COMP-2026 required before storing identifiers.
